notes.title: 2018 season is now live on steam!
notes.content:
The new version 2.2.0.33 has the updated rosters and tournaments for the 2018 season.

This version is the fastest and most stable version of the game so far and features many more improvements in the game play. 

Please notice that you will have to download and apply again any 3rd party patches like the Real Names Patch (the previous one will not work).

You must download also the new Data Editor v.0.56 if you want to edit Teams, Players, Managers and Stadiums as the previous version doesn’t work with the season 2018 databases. Use the links below to get the new Data Editor: 

Windows:
http://www.wbm2game.com/WBM2EditorSetup.exe

Mac:
http://www.wbm2game.com/wbm2EditorMac.zip
In order to run the MacOs Data Editor you must install this first:
https://download.mono-project.com/archive/5.4.1/macos-10-universal/MonoFramework-MDK-5.4.1.6.macos10.xamarin.universal.pkg

notes.title: WBM2 v.2.2.0.29 for MacOs is available on steam.
notes.content:
WBM2 v.2.2.0.29 for MacOs is available on steam.

Changes list:
•	Adds support for the new Data editor. *
•	Human Manager Job offers now work properly.
•	Players’ news creation according to psychology improved.
•	Fixes:
- Statistics crash.
- Localizable news bug.
- The country/continent news crash.
- Turkish cup fixtures problem.
- Injured players roster selection.
- Negative club’s balance
- Apply button in settings problem

Notice that if you are using any 3rd party patches (like the real names patch) you will have to download them again.

* The Data Editor for MacOs will be available on Monday 20th of November.

notes.title: The New WBM2 Data Editor is available for download.
notes.content:
Use this link to download: www.wbm2game.com/WBM2EditorSetup.exe

The editor is still in beta version so expect some bugs (either major or minor).

You need WBM2 version 2.2.0.28 or later installed in order to run the editor.

To make changes in the game database and then start a new game, you have to edit “…Documents/WBM2/template.db3” file. Select File > Open and point to this location. If this location doesn’t exist just run the game once in order to be created.

Click Help >>> Documentation for more info on how the editor works.

Please notice that the data editor is not a trainer and so you can’t edit saves with it. Data editor works only to edit the game database and then to start a new game. Although it might work when you edit a save it might also destroy the save.
